name: Ascension: Echoes in the Dark
source:
It's been five years since the unrest of the Nobles ended. But at what cost?
The darkness is rising, the necromancers are back.
The dead are restless, crying for help.
In the midst of the chaos, a seer will be chosen.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180209140514/http://impqueen.com/ascension-etd.html]ImpQueen[/url]]
